title: Remote candidate task initialization
description: Requires FARMSLOT_CANDIDATE_REMOTE_HOST. Sends the production gateway request to a different execution node, using an owned temporary CLI copy and fixture pool. Starts no farm run, model, device or service.

remote-init.intent: After deleting the gateway candidate source, initialize and verify project-bound and static tasks on the remote node. Retained candidate bytes and hashes must match, staging must be removed on success and provider refusal, and ordinary project/static catalog tasks must still initialize.
